title: Enterprise Support: Compute campaign selection for paid rate-error review
content:
Enterprise Support — Compute campaign selection for paid rate-error review.

## Decision basis

For paid rate-error review: For these on-demand compute export reconstructions, an approved negotiated rate receives no further discount; otherwise an eligible compute promotion reduces the compute price by that compute tier promotion discount, and an absent or expired promotion gives zero discount.

## Points of judgment

For paid rate-error review: A negotiated compute price receives no campaign reduction. Without an approved negotiated price, an eligible compute campaign supplies its tier reduction; an absent or expired campaign supplies zero.
